summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, presenting its Q3 FY2026 unaudited interim financial statements and management discussion for the three and nine months ended July 31, 2026, prepared under IFRS. The filing includes balance sheets, income statements, segment reporting, and equity details for ordinary and preferred shares, with all figures in Canadian dollars. No transaction, strategic event, or special situation is disclosed; it is a routine periodic report by a Canadian bank under the multi-jurisdictional disclosure system. No deal terms are applicable.
